slides.heading: Dolly / Slider
slides.subheading: Movement must serve the story — not distract.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
bullets: Dolly and slider moves add controlled, cinematic motion.
They matter because they feel intentional and smooth.

slides.heading: Pro Tip
slides.text: Use sliders for micro‑moves that elevate simple shots.

slides.heading: Common Mistake
slides.text: Moving too fast and losing cinematic feel.
